about.headline: Comfortable between business questions and technical details.
about.text: Ryan Scott is a Data Operations Coordinator with a background in computer science, software development, QA testing, automotive/SEMA operations, and content creation. He specializes in bridging business needs and technical execution by helping teams clean data, automate workflows, troubleshoot systems, and make better decisions.

resume.headline: Data operations support with a practical systems mindset.
resume.text: Strengths include data validation, reporting workflows, Salesforce support, SQL analysis, QA-style troubleshooting, and clear documentation for cross-functional teams.
